text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a passionate and hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience.

I know this role is for 2D CAD drafting, and while my background is in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, I’ve built a strong eye for clean, customer-friendly presentation and precise digital layouts. In a recent project, I built embedded usage dashboards for a B2B SaaS product so each customer account could see its own metrics, and it was rolled out to 140 customer accounts and delivered 3 weeks early.

I’d be glad to help create clear 2D PDFs/PNGs for your gates first, then support the rest of your catalogue as needed. I’m comfortable working carefully and iterating to make sure dimensions are easy for customers to understand.
